households.name: BFF
households.description: Free spirit Liberty, cheerful Summer, and geeky Travis are unlikely friends, and nothing can come between these three. Except perhaps the growing feelings both Summer and Liberty have for Travis...
households.lot_description: A sprawling colonial with landscaping perfect for outdoor entertaining.

households.name: Caliente
households.description: It’s no longer girls-only now that Caliente matriarch Katrina has moved in her mooching boy toy, Don. With three fiery, attractive ladies in the house, will Don remain faithful or will he get involved with more than one Caliente woman?

households.name: Behr
households.description: Yuki and Candy recently inherited a quaint, modest home from their dearly departed Grandma Behr. Geeky teen Yuki absolutely idolizes her cool DJ sister, Candy, but Yuki’s got some mad skills of her own. Sure, she may not be the edgy Spinmaster Candy is, but she can annihilate anyone at Blicblock. She’s also quickly becoming Windenburg’s most infamous underground hacker.

households.name: Benali
households.description: Salim has grown up in the Arts Quarter, surrounded by poets, musicians and artists. He's determined to become a great writer… right after he's finished that book. Oh, and that video game he needs to beat. Come to think of it, he needs a nap too.
households.lot_description: A cramped apartment with… personality that overlooks the Art Quarter’s lovely center plaza. The cozy kitchen is just big enough and the living room boasts a classic mauve carpet.

households.name: Bheeda
households.description: With a baby on the way and a tiny city apartment, will Jesminder and Arun find space for their bundle of joy? Will Jesminder keep her mixology job when the baby comes, or would she rather stay at home and paint?
households.lot_description: A compact apartment with character in a family friendly neighborhood.

households.name: Bjergsen
households.description: Teen musical prodigy Sofia has dreams -- she's going to make it big. Not even her gloomy dad, perfectionist mom, or pesky genius kid sister can stop her from making her way to the top!

households.name: Free Spirits
households.description: Bookish Maaike and artsy Ulrike aren't materialistic, but even these two roommates admit they could use a few upgrades around the house. Will Maaike be able to sell a few stories, or will Ulrike finally put out a painting that meets her exacting standards?

households.name: Bro
households.description: Tech-savvy hunk Sergio and brash DJ Joaquin have little in common... except for the finer things in life. As they climb the ranks and rake in the bucks, just how awesome can they make their sweet pad?

households.name: Fyres
households.description: Things couldn't be better between lovebirds Dominic and Moira -- too bad the same can't be said for their daughters! Free spirit Morgan just wants to have fun with her Renegade friends, but Siobhan can't stand that attitude. Siobhan is determined to build a network of popular friends who can help her career aspirations. Will Siobhan move out on her own before the tension in the house explodes?

households.name: Feng
households.description: Victor is a respected and high-powered politician. Lily is a tough businesswoman. Their respectful, yet somber nature masks their sinister, secret plans to one day take over San Myshuno!
households.lot_description: Though the exclusive address is reason enough to take this dazzling suite, the upper-level loft and floor to ceiling windows certainly add to the appeal.

households.name: Jang
households.description: Baako and Anaya came to the bustling city of San Myshuno so Baako could broaden his career as a rising comedian and so Anaya could get clarity on which one of her passions to focus on as her career: inspiring songstress or successful painter? Their quirky kiddo, Billie is happy to be along for the ride. This social butterfly has no filter when it comes to making new friends - even if that involves barging in uninvited to her neighbors' apartments!
households.lot_description: Though not the largest apartment in the building, the home studio and funky furnishings are certainly a desirable plus.

households.name: Karaoke Legends
households.description: Miko’s a peppy aspiring politician who shares a room with her basketball-loving buddy, Darling. Their charismatic roommate, Kibo is downright dreamy in Miko’s eyes, but he couldn't be more oblivious to her obvious flirting. Will their mutual love for karaoke bring them together?
households.lot_description: A snug multi-floor apartment with amazing balcony views of the Fashion District.

households.name: Lobo
households.description: Established and novice artists alike shudder in anticipation for the day Diego Lobo steps his critical foot into their gallery. Impress him and you'll have it made for life. But if one brush stroke is off, if just one hue is not quite to his liking, you may never work in this town again.
households.lot_description: Huge floor to ceiling windows combined with a beautiful feature fireplace and a striking view of the Spice Market neighborhood makes this apartment an unforgettable home.

households.name: Munch
households.description: Raising three kids is never easy -- particularly when one refuses to move out of the house, and one is a gloomy rebel. But Mila Munch is nothing if not dedicated to her family, and her sweet little Lucas always cheers her up after a hard day of restaurant work.

households.name: Count Vladislaus Straud IV
households.description: Count Vladislaus Straud IV is the latest descendant to occupy Straud Mansion. His oddly similar looking line of ancestors has resided here since the founding of Forgotten Hollow.
households.lot_description: This mansion has been slowly built up over the town's history. Plenty of space and spare coffins.

households.name: Vatore
households.description: The Vatore siblings moved into Forgotten Hollow a few years ago and are striving to make it their home. This can be quite challenging at times since they are not exactly on the best terms with Vladislaus Straud, but when asked they only ever mention a difference in their culinary tastes.
households.lot_description: This Italianate Victorian manor is large enough to really stretch your wings. Its upscale decor will suit those with a taste for fine design.

households.name: Partihaus
households.description: Drink, flirt, dance, repeat. Jade, Eva, and Paolo jumped at the opportunity to explore the world and set up the ultimate crib in Windenburg as soon as Marcus extended the invite. And the party hasn’t stopped since. Drama is never far behind when they’re together - and they’re always together! With only one and a half jobs between the four of them, how in the world do they manage to pay their bills?

households.name: Pizzazz
households.description: Penny is THE source of the coolest happenings and the latest trends in San Myshuno. But will this Online A-Lister's staunch dedication to her career get in the way of finding romance?
households.lot_description: The perfect starter apartment, this compact studio commands great views of the Fashion District.

households.name: Rasoya
households.description: Raj may be a successful Chef, but his critical mother still worries about when he's going to find a nice girl and carry on the family line…
households.lot_description: A spacious brownstone apartment with bay windows, dockside views and open plan kitchen.

households.name: Villareal
households.description: After Jacques’ wife disappeared under... ahem, mysterious circumstances, he was left raising three kids in his enormous mansion. Luna and Hugo are good kids with typical teen problems, but the youngest, Max, is a terrifying force of nature. Will the kids drive Jacques crazy before his eccentric habits and hobbies drive them crazy?

households.name: Pancakes
households.description: Poor, poor Bob and Eliza – have they ever been happy? It seems there’s nothing one can do to please the other. Just what is keeping this couple together? Or, conversely, what is the spark that will finally drive them apart?

households.name: Amicable Acolytes
households.description: Grace and Tomax have been roommates ever since they first became Spellcasters. They have day jobs, but magic is their main focus, and they've got a friendly competition going to see who will become an Adept Spellcaster first!
households.lot_description: With breathtaking views of Glimmerbrook Falls, this location is perfect for any cozy home.

households.name: Bailey-Moon
households.description: Octavia Moon and Thorne Bailey are the power couple of the century. Octavia is the lyrical genius behind all of Thorne's greatest hits. Due to Thorne's most recent misshap on social media his public image has started to falter. His fans are starting to realize that Octavia is the real talent. Orange is their good natured son but due to his entire life of wanting-for-nothing, he is also a bit naive.
households.lot_description: Bailey Manor is the prefect representation of the new celebrity life style. Nothing but the best and most high tech gadgets are allowed in this house.

households.name: Charm Family
households.description: The Charm family has produced generations of distinguished Spellcasters, as Minerva often reminds her children. Gemma resents her family's high expectations even though she secretly wants to make them proud. Darrel is an aspiring duelist who just got engaged to Emilia, a newly ascended Spellcaster who has a lot to live up to.
households.lot_description: If peace and quiet appeals to you, the Rock Ridge Canyon is perfect. Nestled up against Glimmerbrook's towering boulders, this quaint location is sure to give any Spellcaster the silence they need to practice and study to hone their magical prowess.

households.name: Delgato
households.description: While Supriya loves her full-time job as a stay-at-home mom, it’s been getting harder and harder to suppress her dreams of being a full-fledged veterinarian. Especially now that the owner of the Brindleton Pawspital is looking to sell the business. Her husband Justin has always been supportive, and keeps offering to take a break from work so she can follow her dream. But can Supriya really trust him to keep the peace at home between Blue and Bartholomew? Not to mention Pierce and Evie too!
households.lot_description: With gorgeous porches, a backyard swimming pool, and a phenomenal view of the Brindleton Light, this Dutch colonial is one of the most admired properties in the Bay.

households.name: Greenburg
households.description: Mary and Blossom are a couple of old timers in this town. They're trying to spruce up the place, with Mary focused on her garden and Blossom painting up unused spaces. Age isn't on their side anymore, however. It's a good thing their adopted son Knox is fighting for the family name to help make the world a little more green. Unfortunately, sometimes he takes "fighting" a little too literally.
households.lot_description: Situated right past the entrance gate to Port Promise, this lot provides gorgeous views of the old port while within walking distance to most of the local landmarks.

households.name: Sterling Rico
households.description: Bess and Jules are a power couple with big dreams. Big dreams about sweet, sweet money. A Civil Designer by trade, Bess placed herself in the perfect position to convince city officials and residents alike to enact programs that would benefit her bottom line. Her partner-in-crime, Jules, is a Style Influencer that loves fashion as much as he loves convincing people to buy his rejected styles. Cheerful and charismatic, together they hustle around Evergreen Harbor like an entrepreneurial whirlwind.
households.lot_description: This beautifully repurposed space that sits at the base of the Croftville Dam is a meeting-place of past and present, as a modern home lives in the shell of a classic wood mill.

households.name: Best of Friends
households.description: Julia and Becca have been the best of friends since they first met in kindergarten. Nobody that knows them could imagine them going to university without the other one by her side. Now as they're starting a whole new journey into university it's up to the pair to see if their friendship will survive this new adventure and carry them through to adulthood.
households.lot_description: Wyvern Hall has an all out feud with Drake Hall over who more exemplifies the spirit of Darby, Britechester's mascot. Of course for those that live in Wyvern Hall there is no question which is the superior dorm.

households.name: Elderberry
households.description: Ekram and Eleanore have lived in Gibbs Hill all their lives from young love, to a growing family, and finally into retirement. Eleanore loves seeing the new students appear each term, but Ekram isn't always as fond of the young adults taking over their quiet town. Recently the couple's teenage grandson, Rohan, came to live with them as he prepares to go to university soon. Rohan will soon finish high school and have to make his final decision on what university he wants to attend.
households.lot_description: As one of the two prime locations in Gibbs Hill, Spring Steppes is a lush location with great views of the canals and an easy trip to both the bar and library.

households.name: Fletcher
households.description: Cameron Fletcher is all about learning new things at school, he's just not sure how to make friends with the people around him. But with just a little nudge in the right direction Cameron is sure to master university life.
households.lot_description: Briny Tower is great starter housing for incoming Freshmen. With a new friend in each room and an overlooking view of the whole campus it is one of the best introductions to university life a student could ask for.

households.name: Pleasant
households.description: Angela and Lilith Pleasant have moved into an old family home located in Gibbs Hill to attend the prestigious universities in Britechester. It will be a true test to find out whether their bond as twins can overcome their differences. Their majors have already split them into separate universities, but whether they will be at odds or work together to make it through is a new challenge in their life.
households.lot_description: The prominent half of the spacious two lot complex, Mossy Lane is an idyllic location beneath beautiful blue skies, and an impossible location to forget.

households.name: Ito
households.description: Megumi Ito grew up in Senbamachi. A gold medalist skier, she aims to give her children the same upbringing, but memories of an old flame might drive her to distraction. Naoki Ito is a former medalist himself. A calculating businessman, his controversial vision of Mt. Komorebi includes more tourism, more money, and modernization. Nanami and Kiyoshi have their parents' athletic talent, but their hearts lie elsewhere. Nanami just wants to be a kid and Kiyoshi is crushing on more than the slopes...
households.lot_description: 2-5-1 Wakabamori was a traditional manor home that has been transformed into a contemporary work of art. Seen as the nicest home in the entire prefecture, owning this home makes a bold statement to anyone who cares about that kind of thing.

households.name: New Start
households.description: After living in the big city and having her heart broken, Cecilia decided to ditch everything she knew for a small garden plot and some chickens. She's still looking for someone to share this life with, though after a date she'd love to forget with local Creature Keeper Michael Bell, she's happy to only form long-term attachments with the critters that visit for now.
households.lot_description: A fusion of Old New Henford's historic past and cool present, this old barn has been completely refurbished into a cottage home. Tucked privately between the edge of the Bramblewood and the River Bagley, a Sim could easily forget that the rest of the world exists while in its quaint garden.

households.name: Moody & McMillan
households.description: After working an office job for more years than he'd care to admit, Derek found a man willing to live the rustic dream of his youth and the two moved to his family cottage and never left. When not fending off financial offers from developers who see their home as a prime target, Ian and Derek balance their days between adventure and quiet, depending on who's in charge of the agenda. Despite - or perhaps because of - their differences, time has been most kind to these elderly lovebirds, who live a contented retirement as key members of the Henford-on-Bagley community.
households.lot_description: This old family home is buried deep in the Bramblewood, surrounded by the forest's furry and feathered inhabitants. Like a sturdy yew tree, it's a home that has stood the test of time, with sturdy roots, decades of memories, and a few fresh additions as the years have passed.

households.name: Scott
households.description: As owners of The Gnome's Arms, Finchwick's beloved pub, the Scotts are living the dream! Well, Sara's dream at least. Will their hopes of adding a new member to their tiny family changes things up for better or worse?
households.lot_description: This cozy home sits in the heart of Finchwick and is steps away from the small village's community hub. Though it can get a bit loud on fair days, there's no better place for a Sim who wants to be a part of it all.

households.name: Watson Family
households.description: Inheriting the family estate was always the plan, but Thomas may be in over his head. For a man who equates success with crop size, he's losing both his confidence and his family. While his wife Rahmi loves the country air, her feelings for her husband are becoming stale and her affections have wandered. The oldest of their three children, Rashidah, feels trapped, preferring to dream of a future outside Henford-on-Bagley - dreams that have sparked something between her and a kindred soul. The two youngest couldn't be more different! Imran treasures the security of life at home while Maira can be found bravely venturing out into the unknown. Will this hectic family come together or fall apart in their "old new" home?
households.lot_description: The centerpiece of Old New Henford, this sizeable estate sits perched at the top of Olde Mill Hill and has been part of the Watson family for generations. There's almost too much land for one family to tend, though the sprawling gardens and yard leave plenty of room for growing a variety of crops and keeping a bevy of animals.

households.description: Kyle's just, like, a guy, okay?

households.name: Luna-Sullivan
households.description: The Luna-Sullivan family's a little unusual; Karmine's dad died in a tragic cooking accident, and her mom needed help...so Gramma Eleanor moved in to be the Gramma-in-charge-ish. Except Gramma's just as silly as Karmine is!
households.lot_description: This modern addition to the neighborhood has a lot of curb appeal and plenty to love on the inside, too. Nested within the suburban, tree-filled neighborhood that was developed originally by Gilbert Gilberts, 36 Bayani Place has Dream home written all over it. The street name itself is an homage to Bayani Robles, whose statue is located within the adjacent park.

households.name: Michaelson
households.description: Celeste and Christopher met working at the same startup. They couldn't believe how much they had in common when they first went out for coffee together! After they got married, they adopted Atlas and promptly began spoiling him rotten. Now they've also adopted Orion and are hard at work raising two kids to be just as nerdy as they are.
households.lot_description: Between the gorgeous bay views and the beautiful, tree-lined streets in this neighborhood, this house has a lot to offer a growing family looking for a more upscale feel to things. Enjoy spacious living inside, or take the fun outside in the large, well-appointed yard with plenty for any family member to do—but if you're looking for even more opportunities to get in touch with nature, a park with a small pond is nearby.

households.name: Robles
households.description: The Robles family is pretty entrenched in this community—they've been here ever since the fishing trade started taking off, and for years had a thriving family business. Ignacio's the patriarch of this family, but just because they have deep roots doesn't make them all that conventional. They know everyone and anyone, and love being a part of everything this community has to offer—from spending way too much of their free time down by the waterfront to organizing big family gatherings at Gilbert Gardens park.
households.lot_description: When Bayani Robles first purchased this plot of land and began building Robles Point, he surely never envisioned the legacy his family has gone on to have! This house has had many changes and additions over the year, but it all adds to the home's character and shows that Anchorpoint Wharf is an ever-evolving area where the old and the new come together.

households.name: Robles-Ruano
households.description: The Robles-Ruano Family is a bit on the unconventional side, but being conventional is soooo boring, right? These folks are all about expressing themselves and their personality no matter what. Both parents are hoping that their unique ways will rub off on their slightly clingy daughter, Tala. With a little love, Tala is sure to grow into a confident (and creative!) kid.
households.lot_description: This cozy home is perfect for a small family who still want a bit of space for themselves, and with a backyard that's already treehouse-friendly, you're already set for plenty of outdoors fun! Gilbert Gardens is just across the street so you can look forward to grilling up a meal to enjoy at the gazebo or just taking a dip in the lake. If quiet is what your family is looking for, you've certainly found it!

households.name: The Grove Family
households.description: Umber and Juniper became childhood sweethearts when Umber would serenade Juniper with odes to her Equestrian prowess after taking Horse Riding lessons from his mother. When Umber's parents passed away, he took on the family ranch to honor his native heritage and his sister, Sienna, became the Horse Trainer in town. The son, Wren, has a passion for animals and is training Starbrite, the foal of Umber's childhood rescue horse, Luna... all set to the sweet, peaceful soundtrack of Umber's odes on the porch.
households.lot_description: Trusty Steed Rock, or "Ol' Biscuit," watches over this land as the ever-present, larger-than-life sentinel of the Glen.

households.description: From traditional roots, the Bun Ma family relies on strong familial bonds to get them through life's ups and downs. households.description: Sitting high above the center of Ohan'ali Town, Keala watches over the townsfolk that look to her for guidance. This spirited, young-at-heart grandmother has taken young Lia under her wing to pass on the knowledge and cultural history of Sulani through the generations.
households.lot_description: This traditional home of the tribal leader has been built up over the generations from the earliest island settlement into the modern era. Still it remains the seat of Ohan'ali Town's spiritual and civil influence.

households.name: Hoffman
households.description:
For generations the Hoffman's candy stall was a staple for all kids in Nordhaven. Yet with his wife's passing, and all of his children long moved out, everyone thought that even the tireless Bruno Hoffman would end up selling his business and retire.
What Bruno certainly didn't expect was his grandson Felix, of all people, to volunteer to take up the family's candy making legacy. Life is looking up for this unlikely duo...as long as they manage to steer clear of any more feuds with the Lodens.

households.name: Harjo
households.description: Brought together by their mutual obsession over food, Ava and Lucha fell in love. Ava was recently hired at the High School to work in the cafeteria, and with her expert cooking skills, the food has never been better! Lucha, still learning some chops, was promoted to Head Dishwasher and couldn't be happier. Ash has decided to fully commit to a life of fashion, diving into the Simfluencer lifestyle and spending loads of their time on Trendi. Noah, a bit of a prankster, spends his time training for football and daydreaming about his secret crush, Sidney Price. With teens to raise and recipes to create, the Harjos are in for some wild adventures.
households.lot_description: A charming lot situated on the edge of town, with a natural backdrop and suburban vibes. Perfect view of the famous Copperdale Water Tower - climbing prohibited.

households.name: Prescott
households.description: Passed down through generations, this historic estate is home to the Prescott Family. Mei Prescott, Copperdale's High School Principal, lives here with her two daughters and her father, Tai Lum. After her husband's passing, Mei put all her efforts into protecting her girls and showering them with affection. Often times to an embarrassing degree. Molly is a star student with a secret passion for music. Taking a page from her troublemaker little sister Amy, she's learning to embrace her more rebellious side. Tai enjoys time with his grandchildren, especially the extra moments he has with Molly when working at the school as a janitor. Together, the family proudly carries on the legacy of the Prescott name.
households.lot_description: An estate worthy plot of land sits elegantly overlooking Copperdale. Pinkies up!

households.name: Price
households.description: High school sweethearts and Copperdale alumni Janae and Marcel Price have returned, moving back into their old neighborhood with their three children: Sidney, Savannah, and Jayden. They also welcomed Kevin, a foreign exchange student, into their lively home. It's a busy household, stirring with activity and thriving pursuits. While Marcel works on his latest novel, Janae works full-time as a successful Regional Manager. The twins, Savannah and Sidney, each enjoy their own interests while trying to keep up good grades. Jayden looks up to his siblings a lot, and can't wait to be just like them, his buddy Kevin included. Life can certainly get away from them, but they know they can always depend on one another.
households.lot_description: Close to the essentials and a tunnel into town, it's a comfortable spot for anyone's needs. Includes nearby access to a favorite teen hideaway. At least they're off the lawn.

households.name: Jeong
households.description: Venessa Jeong just moved to Del Sol Valley from her quaint country town. She is looking to make it big as a rising actress. She has stared in a few low level commercials, but her agent always tells her she has what it takes she just needs to find that breakthrough role.
households.lot_description: Upland Place is small but has everything you could ever need to start your journey to becoming the next Global Superstar.

households.name: Amri
households.description: It finally happened—armed with a guitar and rose-tinted optimism, Zain found the courage to leave their family home and pursue their true passion: singing.\nSure, most people don't make it far in the music industry, but what's the point if you don't even try? Zain is ready to grab life by the horns!

households.name: Kahananui
households.description: As the self-appointed “Sulani ambassadors” this enterprising couple, Mele and Alika, have decided to live out their golden years in a dream retreat away from the bustle of Ohan’ali Town.
households.lot_description: Retreat into the ultimate island experience where relaxing into the sun and sand are within a short walk from the front door.

households.name: Kealoha
households.description: The Kealohas are the epitome of Sulani: an industrious, welcoming, and tight-knit young family firmly rooted in island tradition to honor the past while supporting the bright future of their extended-family community.
households.lot_description: Once an old fishing-boat dock, Kin-Ship was recently repurposed into a charming waterfront home. This sizeable waterfront lot is now perfect for an active, close-knit family.

households.name: Koopman
households.description: For decades, the beautifully fired ceramics of the Koopman family have been a staple in Nordhaven. But when Gert took over the family shop in his youth he wasn't confident he could run it all on his own, that is until he met Jolanda. It was love at first glaze, and together the Terra-Potta grew more successful than ever. Yet things can change with time. After many years of marriage, including a daughter who has moved out to university, Jolanda and Gert are not seeing eye to eye as much as they used to. Much of their time is spent apart; while she looks after the main shop, he often handles the stalls at the local markets—where he's been noticed as particularly friendly with some of the clientele, at least according to the gossips. Can this couple reignite their passion, or is this love broken beyond repair?
households.lot_description: Surrounded by green open space, this is the ideal island of tranquility to take a break from the brutality of the city's industrial buildings.

households.name: Landgraab
households.description: The Landgraabs seem like the perfect family; wealthy, well-mannered, brilliant. But Nancy and Geoffrey are each hiding something. Will their secrets tear them apart or will they continue to build a wealthy dynasty?

households.name: Loden
households.description: Since Gammelvik's founding there's always been a Koffieboon cafe, and it's always had the Lodens behind it. When it was her turn to run the business, Nora stepped in happily, but who will step in after her? Nora's daughter, Freya, never had much interest in inheriting the cafe, much preferring her deep love for dancing. Meanwhile the younger son, Erik, shows a lot more aptitude for crafting with clays and paints than he does business. Now Nora's feeling pressured to not disappoint the legacy of her late father and the many Lodens before him, even despite reassurances from her mama, Hattie. Thankfully, she has her wife Dahlia there to support her—and provide an escape or two through her critically acclaimed, titillating romance novels.
households.lot_description: Right in the heart of Gammelvik, this classic four-bedroom building lives at the center of this city's community and history.

households.name: Lynx
households.description: Cats in the neighborhood know where to go for a good meal. Catarina’s always had a soft spot for animals, and the cats she lives with have the best home a cat could ask for.  Sometimes Catarina asks herself if there’s something more to life than cats… usually right before she adopts another stray.
households.lot_description: Smackdab in the middle of Whiskerman’s Wharf, this modest home is absolutely perfect for someone who can’t get enough of the frenetic felines that hang out by the docks.

households.name: Tinker
households.description: The talented, but perpetually stressed Tina Tinker is a very successful Freelance Crafter. Her equally successful spouse, Yasemin, managed to convince her to move to Conifer Station with their daughter, Olive. Tina takes on too much work, and Yasemin just wants her to relax and spend more time with family. Meanwhile, curious little Olive loves nothing more than to admire her two mothers' works and dream of following in their footsteps.
households.lot_description: Built by railroad financier Gregory Pigulock during the early development of Evergreen Harbor, this mansion twice suffered damage from local storms before being declared a historic landmark and being restored to its current glory.

households.name: Ngata
households.description: Coming to Sulani for inspiration Leila didn't expect to fall in love so deeply with the islands. And it wasn't just the scenery that she fell for, but also for Oliana and her son Tane that welcomed her so easily into their family. The three are now an insperable trio that call Sulani their home enjoying the sand and ocean at their own pace.
households.lot_description: This remote beachfront loft mixes contemporary design with traditional elements as it sits on the edge of island civilization and marine bliss.

households.name: Nyhus
households.description:
Corey goes with the flow, loving each day as it comes. Serving drinks from behind the counter, he watches as people flirt and new passions bloom.
He wonders if, one day, he too might find somebody to love.

households.name: Sarpong
households.description: After years of apprenticeship with a pair of underground tattoo artists, Nia moved back to Nordhaven to pursue the dream of opening her own tattoo studio in the city where she grew up. But on top of the new set of skills and business ambition, she also came back with a child. Her daughter, Lerato, was just as thrilled to move to a new place...hoping to get the highest room and be even closer to the constellations she loves studying. This is the beginning of a new chapter in Nia's life, as she begins to wonder what will be more challenging: being a single parent or starting her own business?
households.lot_description: With this lot, you can reach for the stars. This beautiful industrial-conversion is perfect for anyone looking for ample space to pursue their hobbies and dreams.

households.name: Cahill
households.description: George Cahill was a retired pilot who enjoyed taking his beloved plane Penelope for long flights across the world. After passing over StrangerVille there was a large flash of light causing his plane to short circuit and crash. George has since set up camp in the cargo bay of Old Penelope, and has lived on the outskirts of StrangerVille ever since. Although he has grown skeptical of the residents of StrangerVille he means no harm and mostly keeps to himself.
households.lot_description: Old Penelope is the tried and true cargo plane of George Cahill. She has put in many long years shuttling goods back and forth across the world. Unfortunately a freak storm while flying over StrangerVille has put her out of commission. Hopefully one day George will muster up enough energy to put the old horse back together.

households.name: Eclectic Arts Household
households.description: The Eclectic Arts Household consists of three friends who have decided to cut ties with the modern world in order to explore their inner creativity. They received a large sum of money from their parents, and are using it to explore their creative dreams in a less hectic town.
households.lot_description: Dream Weavers Way is tucked high atop a plateau where you can hear the babbling brook and embrace your inner creative self. Perfect for any starving artist that is just looking to get away from it all.

households.name: Roswell
households.description: The Roswell's are the oldest residents in StrangerVille. Ted Roswell has since become the mayor and has been aggressively pushing to get StrangerVille to be more technologically advanced. He has made some shady deals, but his crowning achievement has been the construction of the Crater Base and Secret Lab. Ted's wife, Meredith, has been noticing Ted acting very strange at night. It might have something to do with his frequent visits to the Secret Lab to try and cover things up.
households.lot_description: With the best views of the StrangerVille Plaza the StrangerVille Overlook is the perfect place to keep a watchful eye on the tiny town of StrangerVille.

households.name: Sigworth
households.description: The Sigworth family is rather new in town. Jess, the mom, had to transfer to the StrangerVille National Base. After spending a few days on the base Dylan has started to notice something is a bit off about his wife. Although Dylan is doing all he can to reassure their daughter that everything is okay. Christie is starting to catch on and it is only a matter of time until she realizes what is going on.
households.lot_description: Located on a spacious corner lot in the StrangerVille Plaza The Riverside Grove is a quaint home for a small family.

households.name: Urbane Housesharers
households.description: When Cannonball moved to Nordhaven he first made his coin performing at The Rouge Note. Locals loved his music, and it wasn't long before he set his sights on buying the venue and fulfilling the old dream of running his own jazz lounge—alas, he was still a few coins short. A new opportunity came around when Cannonball met Crispin, who in his own youth had spent a little too much on post-modern art sculptures, but was now looking to save some Simoleons for his adoptive kid Ollie. Before long they all moved in together and have been splitting the bills since. Now yes, Crispin can sometimes be too pompous, and sure, Cannonball can't afford the lounge quite just yet, but our dreamer has really found his groove in this new city. And as a man who's never had a chance to be a father, he's grown quite fond of having Ollie in his life.
households.lot_description: Back in the day this brick building functioned as a small foundry used to produce metal castings. It's now been repurposed as a contemporary living space, with an added top floor for a scenic view of the central areas of Iverstad.

households.name: Ward
households.description: Judith Ward is a legend in the acting community. She has starred in everything from comedies to dramas. You name it Judith has played the role. That is not to say she is an easy person to befriend. Judith has burned her fair share of bridges along the way. Her mentality is to get rich at all costs. She will be the first to throw you under the bus to advance her career. She has been married several times, but all of her partners have only slowed her down. She prefers to live fast and does not settle for mediocrity.
households.lot_description: The Ward Den is home to the most prestigious celebrity, Judith Ward. She has built her empire way back in the day when Del Sol Valley was a small speck on the map of Fame and Stardom.

households.description: Shortly after Lou's arrival in Moonwood Mill, he tried to impress his date Celene by taunting the town's notoriously feral werewolf, Greg. His poor decision led to painful consequences for both him and Celene, but while she sought a remedy, Lou figured he could just ride this one out...which didn't turn out as anticipated. Will this master of mischief learn to love his new inner wolf or will he try and find a way out of the mess he's found himself in?

However, she got more than she bargained for while on a midnight date in the woods. Thankfully, she discovered an antidote which prevented her transformation. She's more cautious now, but her position as the local barkeep gives her a front row view to the wondrous world of werewolves without the risk of injury.

households.name: Oaklow
households.description: Most of Moonwood Mill knows Rory as the leader of the Wildfangs, but she first arrived as a confused young werewolf under the care of Kristopher Volkov. He tried to counsel control and to nurture her like one of his garden flowers, but the two grew apart as Rory grew up. His ideals and values stifled her inner wolf until Rory chose to listen to the beast inside her and moved out to form her own pack. Nowadays, Rory may seem like she has it all figured out, but deep down, she's still discovering how to be the leader she always wished Kristopher could have been.

households.name: Volkov
households.description: Kristopher Volkov has been around longer than most can remember. He founded and leads the Moonwood Collective, and is eager to take in any werewolf feeling displaced or lost.\n\nLily joined the household long ago, a lonely wanderer who had lost her closest friends to the vampires. After her came Rory, then Jacob. Though Rory's relationship with her adoptive father has soured, Jacob and Kristopher's connection has flourished. Both bear the same calm yet intense soul, and everyone in Moonwood Mill knows Kristopher intends for Jacob to be the heir to his pack.
households.lot_description: Nestled on the outskirts of Lake Lunvik, Kristopher Volkov created a home for himself and those in need. He's made room for all who have joined him over the years, with the homey garden and shed out back ensuring those who live here can live a self-sustainable lifestyle in peaceful solitude.

households.name: Wilder
households.description: Wolfgang has lived in Moonwood Mill for decades, where he's been documenting the history of werewolves and trying to give them a brighter future. A famous author who specializes in werewolf "fiction," his books have introduced the idea of the “friendly neighborhood werewolf” into popular culture. Because he uses a pen name, nobody realizes he himself is actually the very thing he champions.

households.name: Zest
households.description: Johnny Zest has the stage name and the dream, but maybe not the talent... Disowned by the Landgraabs for quitting school, Johnny wants to make his own fame and fortune as a standup comedian.

households.name: Roomies
households.description: This household seems to have stepped right out of a TV sitcom. What wacky misadventures will the perky Zoe, easygoing Mitchell, uptight ladies’ man J, and intellectual Gavin suffer this week? Tune in and find out!

households.name: Spencer-Kim-Lewis
households.description: Okay, here’s the breakdown: Dennis Kim and Lydia Spencer had a daughter named Alice Spencer-Kim, then divorced. Alice married Eric Lewis and had her own little girl, Olivia Kim-Lewis. They live with Alice’s dad (Dennis, remember?) and Eric’s mom, Vivian Lewis. Hey, no one ever said family was easy!
households.lot_description: A large property with classical styling, this is the quintessential Garden Estates home.

dynasties.name: Landgraab
dynasties.description: The Landgraabs seem like the perfect family; wealthy, well-mannered, brilliant. Yet, under that polished surface, they hide internal conflicts and a cut-throat agenda.

dynasties.name: Alto
dynasties.description: Passionate, loving...and toxic. That's the Alto trademark.

dynasties.name: Capp
dynasties.description: Everyone in Bellacorde admires the Capps and their family words, Bound By Honor. Theirs is an illustrious Dynasty known by many as romantic, chivalrous and proud. Some would also describe them as vain, elitist and melodramatic.

dynasties.name: Goth
dynasties.description: The Goths are an aristocratic family with a dreary aura and more than one skeleton in the closet. Perhaps it is their familiarity with death that fuel their deep passion?

dynasties.name: Monty
dynasties.description: After generations of drama and conflict with the Capps, the Montys are ready to rise from the ashes and claim back their power.

dynasties.name: Abrantes
dynasties.description: The Abrantes have risen through the ranks to be known as the most refined Dynasty in Verdemar. But don't be misled by appearances: they always know how to get what they want.

dynasties.name: Darong
dynasties.description: The Darongs are a philanthropic Dynasty who have worked tirelessly over generations to bring Dambele into a golden age of flourishing arts and wealth. Their family words are spoken throughout Dambele: Strength Through Union.

dynasties.name: Thebe
dynasties.description: Strong as the tides, fierce as the sea, the Thebe are recognized by their family words: We Ride The Storm. This Dynasty is proud of their adventures and the treasures they've collected. Theirs is a mixed lineage which counts both princesses and pirates in their ancestry.
